notes: ABox revision on spouse_of (functional, symmetric): Marie Curie's husband is Winston Churchill instead of Pierre Curie. Churchill was chosen because, like Marie Curie, he married only once and his wife Clementine is well known. The related question asks about a different person reached through the marriage: the brother of her husband (Jacques Curie, then Jack Churchill), a 2-hop composition; the symmetric reading (Churchill's wife) was dropped because it is the same marriage read from his side. Derived: a binding (the first woman to win a Nobel Prize) and two compositions on Churchill's stored facts (Prime Minister, Nobel Prize in Literature). The indeterminate question is the 1903 physics prize co-winner (w2 is lopsided and kept unweighted, README Decisions 4). The Chinese question uses 居里夫人, the usual Chinese name. Counts are exact-phrase Dolma counts unless marked approximate.
